incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag spike on payment events
incidents.first_response: Pause non-critical backfills and inspect processing-service logs for payment topic errors.
incidents.mitigation: Scale processing workers and replay retry topic after Postgres write latency returns to normal.

incidents.title: Analytics API p95 latency regression
incidents.first_response: Check Redis health and compare slow queries against sql/explain probes.
incidents.mitigation: Warm hot tenant cache and reduce dashboard date windows while investigating query plan drift.

incidents.title: Daily revenue reconciliation drift

incidents.mitigation: Run tenant daily metrics backfill, then rerun reconciliation and invalidate urgent cache keys.
